name: Efreeti

additionalSources.name: Savage Species, 3.0 fire subtype example on p. 169
Wizards of the Coast, original SRD spells in the complete 2004 compilation

evidence: Heat first appears at level 2. Level 3 grants produce flame and pyrotechnics at will. Flight arrives at level 4, Large size at level 10, and wish at level 18. The class grants no command spell. Its telepathy supports the quartermaster’s orders.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

name: Flamebrother Salamander

additionalSources.name: Savage Species, weapon table on p. 45

evidence: Level 4 is the first tier with Constrict. It retains level 2 heat 1d4 and level 3 natural armor +5. The entry gives a cold-save penalty and double damage from cold attacks that offer no save.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

name: Athach
evidence: The third arm is available from level 1. Bite begins at 2 and Strength poison at 3. Level 3 uses its own printed base saves +1/+1/+3, avoiding the apparent level-2 Fortitude typo. Large size and bonus Multiattack both arrive at level 9.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

name: Grig

additionalSources.name: Wizards of the Coast, original SRD irresistible dance in the complete 2004 compilation

evidence: The Grig remains at half a d6 for all four levels. Class level 4 has SR 17 and first grants attune fiddle. The spell-like abilities continue to use 9th-level sorcerer caster level.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.

name: Harpy

additionalSources.name: Savage Species, Harpy Siren example on pp. 86–87

evidence: Player flight begins at level 3. Level 4 grants only a 10-ft. song. The Harpy Siren example on pp. 86–87 establishes approach, hazards, and defenses for the same ability, with the class table overriding the example’s radius and DC.
catalogStatus: Missing playable profile at batch baseline.
